children: As of June 30, 2026, Mastercard Asia Pacific held 49,724,182 Pine Labs shares, representing a 4.31 per cent stake, according to exchange data

Mastercard Asia Pacific is set to sell up to 49.7 million shares, representing approximately 4.3 per cent of fintech company Pine Labs, through a block deal worth up to Rs 892.5 crore, according to media reports.  The shares are priced at a floor price of Rs 179.50 apiece, a 7.3 per cent discount to Pine Labs’ previous closing price on the NSE.

The transaction, scheduled for September 22, is structured as a 100 per cent secondary sale, with Mastercard Asia/Pacific as the selling shareholder. Citigroup Global Markets India Private Limited is the sole placement agent, as per media reports.

As of June 30, 2026, Mastercard Asia Pacific held 49,724,182 Pine Labs shares, representing a 4.31 per cent stake, according to exchange data. The proposed sale of up to 49.7 million shares is broadly equivalent to its entire disclosed stake, according to media reports.

The books opened on September 21 and are scheduled to close on September 22 at around 7:30 am IST, with an option for earlier closure. The expected trade date is September 22, while settlement is scheduled for September 23. No pricing guidance will be provided until the shares are crossed on the exchanges on September 22, according to the transaction document.

Pine Labs made its stock market debut on November 14, 2025, following an IPO that raised around Rs 3,900 crore. The shares listed at Rs 242 apiece on the NSE, a 9.5 per cent premium to the IPO issue price of Rs 221.
As this is a secondary sale, the proceeds from the transaction will accrue to Mastercard Asia/Pacific and not to Pine Labs.
